# Traefik — root-to-custom-context-sse

Proxy at /, app on /app context, PUSH over Server-Sent Events. The event stream and the client-to-server POSTs both ride the same prefix-adding router, and the session cookie and forwarded prefix are arranged as in the WebSocket sibling.

Proxy URL on `http://localhost:9090`: `/`

## Configuration

See [docker-compose.yml](./docker-compose.yml) for service definitions.

Traefik dynamic config (`vaadin.yml`), mounted into
`/etc/traefik/dynamic`:

```yaml
# Proxy at /, app on the /app context, PUSH over Server-Sent Events through a
# proxy that cannot upgrade a connection.
#
# Everything root-to-custom-context has to arrange applies here too — the
# session cookie path and the forwarded prefix, both in the compose file — and
# the event stream rides the same prefix-adding router as everything else. So
# do the client-to-server XHR POSTs, which go to the same path.
http:
  routers:
    vaadin:
      rule: PathPrefix(`/`)
      entryPoints:
        - web
      middlewares:
        - no-websocket
        - add-app
        - forwarded-root
        - compress
      service: vaadin

  services:
    vaadin:
      loadBalancer:
        servers:
          - url: http://vaadin:8080

  middlewares:
    # Traefik upgrades on every route, so the only way to build a proxy that
    # cannot is to remove the client's upgrade intent. An empty value deletes
    # the header rather than setting it empty.
    no-websocket:
      headers:
        customRequestHeaders:
          Upgrade: ""
          Connection: ""

    add-app:
      addPrefix:
        prefix: /app

    # addPrefix does not emit X-Forwarded-Prefix — only stripPrefix does — so
    # it is set by hand here. The backend's context path is /app but its public
    # prefix is the root, and this is the only way to say so. Spring trims the
    # trailing slash, so getContextPath() ends up empty.
    #
    # "/" and not "": an empty value would REMOVE the header instead.
    forwarded-root:
      headers:
        customRequestHeaders:
          X-Forwarded-Prefix: "/"

    compress:
      compress:
        excludedContentTypes:
          - text/event-stream
          - text/plain
```

The entryPoints and the file provider come from the shared
[traefik.yml](../../traefik.yml), mounted read-only.
